{{Quote|They have my ship. I can get us out of here, but the rest are on their own.|Kessk to [[Esu]]|<ref name="Lockdown (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.47|Lockdown (comic story)}}</ref>}}
'''Kessk''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kessk was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tempestuous]]'' while he was transported to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the voyage, the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Arlain Zee]] escaped from his cell and proceeded to free Kessk and several other captured bounty hunters. However, Kessk was soon [[Riot aboard the Tempestuous|recaptured]] by Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] while attempting to access the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay.
